What will I be doing?
Contribute to our technical architecture as we scale to serve millions of end users.
Care about agility as much as you care for scalability and availability. Continuous deployment keeps us focused on incremental releases. Make your mark immediately; ship changes to production in your first week, and roll out a significant release just after. At Intercom, we average 80 deployments each weekday.

What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters
Salesforce AI Research is a global leader in Enterprise AI, driving innovations that advance the state of AI while powering enterprise products at worldwide scale. We take ideas from research to real-world impact, working closely with product teams and enterprise customers to translate cutting-edge research into production AI capabilities used by millions of users. Learn more at Salesforce AI Research .
Within AI Research, our Incubation team bridges our foundational technology and our customers' needs. We meet with customers to understand their biggest pain points, connect them to emerging technologies from our researchers' work, and validate those technologies with real users to inform our future products.
We sit at the intersection of research and product innovation, combining AI research and applied AI to turn foundational innovation into real solutions for real customers. We are looking for a Summer 2027 intern to help us validate and shape what we build next.
Core Responsibilities & Scope
Design user research plans to help validate pilots and experiments
Conduct discovery interviews and synthesize learnings
Produce reports of user studies and their outcome
Make recommendations for pilot direction and future experiments
Establish standardized research protocols, templates, and assessment frameworks for unified user evaluations
Collaborate with researchers, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate research findings into recommendations for product development.
Minimum Requirements
Currently pursuing a graduate degree in a relevant field, such as Human-Computer Interaction, Information Science, Business, Economics, Psychology, or a related discipline.
Experience conducting qualitative or quantitative research, including interviews, surveys, or experimental studies.
Ability to analyze and synthesize research findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Interest in artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, and understanding how people interact with technology.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience conducting user research, usability testing, or customer discovery for software or AI-powered applications.
Familiarity with research methods such as experimental design, A/B testing, longitudinal studies, or adoption analysis.
Experience working with qualitative and quantitative research tools, including Excel, SQL, Python, R, or survey platforms.
Understanding of product incubation, technology adoption, and business impact measurement.
Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams or conducting research in an industry setting.
Ability to vibe-code tools that help in the synthesis and collection of data at scale.
Internship Details
This is a Summer 2027 internship with a minimum duration of 12 weeks.

postings.title: Product Management Intern (Summer 2027)
postings.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
We’re looking for dedicated students who share our passion for ground-breaking technology and want to create a lasting future for you and Snowflake.
WHAT WE OFFER:
- Paid, full-time internships in the heart of the software industry
- Post-internship career opportunities (full-time and/or additional internships)
- Exposure to a fast-paced, innovative culture
- A chance to work with world-class experts on challenging projects
- Opportunity to provide meaningful contributions to real systems used by customers
- High level of access to supervisors (manager and mentor), detailed direction without micromanagement, feedback throughout your internship, and a final evaluation
- Stuff that matters: treated as a member of the Snowflake team, included in company meetings/activities, flexible hours, casual dress code, access to our great office and benefits at the Menlo Park office
WHAT WE EXPECT:
- Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college/university program during the time of the internship
- Desired class level: 1st/2nd year MBA Students
- Interest in Product Management and the technology industry
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Ability to work as part of a team
- Dedication and passion for technology
- When: Summer (May/June- September)
- Duration: 12 weeks
WHAT YOU WILL LEARN/GAIN:
- How to contribute to product strategy and planning
- Experience in market research and competitive analysis
- Exposure to product design and user experience principles, particularly in the era of AI
- Understanding of data-driven decision-making
- Experience working with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, marketing)
- Opportunity to present findings and recommendations to senior management
POSSIBLE TEAMS/WORK FOCUS AREAS:
We are hiring in a few teams and your focus may include:
- Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
- Data Engineering and Development
- Snowsight and user interface development
- Product Platform (Billing & Monetization, Application Collaboration Frameworks, Database Security, Privacy, and Governance, etc..)
- Data Platform (Data Pipelines & Streaming, Metadata, Storage & Data Lake, etc..), and our Service Runtime (Inc’l Snowpark & SnowPandas, Container Services, etc..)

Finance Strategy & Planning Intern
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
Who We Are:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
Job Description:
At Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), we advance the way people live and work by delivering intelligent, secure, AI-powered networking solutions that connect people, devices, and applications everywhere.
We are looking for an ambitious and high-potential Finance Intern to join our UKI Sales Finance organisation in HPE Winnersh. This is an exciting entry-level opportunity designed for an individual at the beginning of their career who is eager to develop their knowledge and skills over their 13-month placement with HPE.
You will receive ongoing mentoring, coaching, and practical experience supporting financial forecasting across multiple business segments, gaining hands-on experience driving critical finance processes, and preparing reporting packages for senior leaders, as well as exposure to business development, networking technologies and AI-driven solutions. The role combines business support, customer engagement and community-building activities, providing an excellent foundation for a successful career in Business Finance.
Location: Winnersh, UK
Start Date: 1 July 2027 (13-month placement)
What you'll do:
Supporting UKI business forecasting, with specific focus on driving operational progress and forecast predictability for the GreenLake business.
Supporting material vendor rebate tracking and financial recovery across UKI.
Presenting and clearly communicating important financial information on a weekly and quarterly basis using a variety of mediums.
Creating and providing reporting packs for senior executives that present financial performance within the business and assist in crucial decision-making processes.
Providing valuable feedback, thoughts and opinions to the finance and strategy teams, using an analytical approach.
Supporting community-building activities across the wider HPE Winnersh site.
What you'll need:
Currently in the second year of an undergraduate degree (three years, or four including an industrial placement) and available for a 13-month placement from 1 July 2027.
A degree background that can demonstrate finance, business and analytical skills is preferable.
On track to achieve a 2:1
Ability to demonstrate some work experience or participation in meaningful extra-curricular activities.
Ability to use the Microsoft Office package to a high standard (particularly Excel and PowerPoint).
Accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong time management and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks effectively and to learn and act within limited time constraints.
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively using different mediums.
Strong work ethic, a willingness to grow and develop with HPE, and a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
Ability to work with a level head under pressure.
A great team player who is also able to work independently.
